reason: Both conversations correctly reassured the homeowner that wet plastics are normal, identified the empty rinse aid and Eco programme as the causes, and avoided any part or engineer recommendation. Conversation 2 gave a more accurate explanation (condensation drying rather than 'skipping a heated dry phase'), covered all the sensible fixes including waiting before unloading and loading for drainage (both relevant hidden facts Conversation 1 never touched), and clearly framed the fault scenario as conditional on plates being wet and lukewarm. Conversation 1 was admirably concise and asked the right two questions, but its first answer was overly long and initially overwhelmed the customer, which is why the margin is only slight.
